title: Cost Deposit Schedule of the Legal Forwarding Agreements
content:
## Cost deposit schedule

This schedule forms part of the Legal Forwarding Agreements and states, programme by programme, the cost deposit the creditor client lodges with Ridgeline for court costs and the time limits attached to it.

| Programme | Deposit to lodge before the first forwarding | Minimum deposit balance | Days to replenish after falling below the minimum | Days the deposit may stay below the minimum before forwarding is suspended | Days to refund the unused deposit after the tail ends |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Attorney Demand Program | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0 | 0 | 30 |
| Small Claims Suit Program | $500.00 | $200.00 | 15 | 30 | 30 |
| Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program | $2500.00 | $1000.00 | 15 | 30 | 45 |
| Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Judgment Enforcement Program | $1000.00 | $500.00 | 15 | 30 | 30 |
| Full-Service Litigation Program | $5000.00 | $2000.00 | 30 | 45 | 45 |

### Column definitions

(a) **Deposit to lodge before the first forwarding** — the cost deposit the client must lodge before the first forwarding, in USD; $0.00 where none is required. The Attorney Demand Program and the Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program require none.

(b) **Minimum deposit balance** — the deposit balance below which the client must replenish, in USD.

(c) **Days to replenish** — the calendar days after the deposit falls below the minimum within which the client must replenish.

(d) **Days below the minimum before suspension** — the calendar days the deposit may stay below the minimum before forwarding is suspended; 0 where no deposit is required.

(e) **Days to refund** — the calendar days after the active matter tail ends within which the unused deposit is refunded.

### Reading the minimum balance

"Below the minimum" is strictly less than the figure in column (b). Taking the Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program as an example on hypothetical balances: a deposit balance of $1000.00 equals the minimum and is not below it; a balance of $999.99 is below it, and the client must then replenish within 15 calendar days.

### Hypothetical comparison

| Programme | Hypothetical deposit balance | Below the minimum? |
|---|---|---|
| Small Claims Suit Program | $200.00 | No — equal to $200.00 |
| Small Claims Suit Program | $150.00 | Yes — below $200.00; replenish within 15 days |
| Judgment Enforcement Program | $499.00 | Yes — below $500.00; replenish within 15 days |
| Full-Service Litigation Program | $2500.00 | No — above $2000.00 |
| Full-Service Litigation Program | $1999.99 | Yes — below $2000.00; replenish within 30 days |

The balances in these tables are invented for illustration and describe no client.
